claims: You can run OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra inside Claude Code and stop burning through Claude token limits
Pattern: make Fable the boss and Astra the worker; they hand work back and forth and check each other
You get both models while using less of each
Setup needs a ChatGPT account, a Claude account, Codex and Claude Code installed, the connecting plugin, and a few CLAUDE.md sections
how_to_steps: Have both a ChatGPT (Codex) and Claude subscription; install Codex CLI and Claude Code
In Claude Code run /plugin marketplace add openai/codex-plugin-cc, then /plugin install codex@openai-codex, then /reload-plugins
Add an 'AI Collaboration Rules' section to CLAUDE.md telling Claude when to ask Astra/Codex for an opinion and to have Codex review final changes
Work normally: Claude plans, consults Astra via the skill, implements, then asks Codex to review and fixes valid findings before running tests
on_screen_only: Terminal: '/plugin marketplace add openai/codex-plugin-cc' -> 'Successfully added marketplace: openai-codex'; '/reload-plugins' -> 'Reloaded: 8 plugins . 83 skills . 6 agents . 3 hooks . 35 plugin MCP servers . 0 plugin LSP servers'; 'codex@openai-co... Use Codex from Claude Code to review code or...'; '> /plugin install codex@openai-codex'; 'auto mode on (shift+tab to cycle)'

Claude Code transcript: 'Skill(astra-advisor:astra-advisor) Successfully loaded skill', 'Read 2 files, ran 2 shell commands', 'Codex CLI is available. Now I'll write the brief and consult Astra.', 'Astra's verdict is in. Now I'll build the landing page directly with plain HTML/CSS/JS as recommended.', 'Write(index.html) Wrote 424 lines', title 'Flowstate - Focus on what matters', 'The page is built. Now let's have Codex review it.'

CLAUDE.md excerpt titled '# AI Collaboration Rules': 'When a task is complicated, use Codex or Astra for a second opinion. For important technical decisions: 1. Ask Astra for an independent opinion. 2. Review the advice. 3. Make the final decision. 4. Implement the change. 5. Use Codex to review the final changes. 6. Fix valid problems found by the review. 7. Run the tests before finishing. Do not use Astra or Codex for every small task. The main Claude Code session remains responsible for the final decision.'
